ACE-AKEDEMEIA_DECK.description: Whenever you Consume or Flip red Stock, deal 4 damage to ALL enemies.
ACE-AKEDEMEIA_DECK.flavor: Standard issue, and never quite standard.
ACE-AKEDEMEIA_DECK.title: Akedemeia Deck
ACE-ARCANE_DECK.description: Whenever you Consume or Flip, Stock a white card.
ACE-ARCANE_DECK.flavor: The blank card is never blank for long.
ACE-ARCANE_DECK.title: Arcane Deck
ACE-BLACK_TRUMP.description: Whenever you Flip, increase the Flip level by 1.
ACE-BLACK_TRUMP.flavor: One card outranks the whole deck.
ACE-BLACK_TRUMP.title: Black Trump
ACE-CRAZY_EIGHTS.description: Whenever you Flip Spectrum or 4 of the same color, gain 1 Energy.
ACE-CRAZY_EIGHTS.flavor: Four suits, one hand, no rules.
ACE-CRAZY_EIGHTS.title: Crazy Eights
ACE-DRACONIC_DECK.description: While red is your Majority, your Attacks deal 1 additional damage.
ACE-DRACONIC_DECK.title: Draconic Deck
ACE-MAGICIANS_DECK.description: Draw 1 additional card at the start of your turn if yellow is your Majority.
ACE-MAGICIANS_DECK.flavor: The hand is quicker than the eye.
ACE-MAGICIANS_DECK.title: Magician's Deck
ACE-MYTHRIL_DECK.description: Whenever you Flip blue Stock, increase the Flip level by 1.
ACE-MYTHRIL_DECK.flavor: Light enough to throw, hard enough to stop a blade.
ACE-MYTHRIL_DECK.title: Mythril Deck
ACE-PLAYING_CARDS.description: You have 4 Stock slots. Colored cards Stock their color when played. Stocks can be Consumed or Flipped by card effects. Flipped cards become stronger based on the amount of Stock used.
ACE-PLAYING_CARDS.title: Playing Cards
